How It Works

Four tags. One rule: proof before price.

Thrift stores color-code their tags by the week to track price drops. We color-code ours by step — so you always know where an item is in the pipeline.

Red tag

List & Scan

Seller photographs the item. Our app captures brand, condition, and every detail shot the AI needs.

Yellow tag

AI Authentication

Logos, stitching, hardware, and materials get checked against verified brand references.

Blue tag

QR Certificate

A pass generates a unique QR tied to that exact item — not reused, not editable, yours to check anytime.

Green tag

Bid & Win

The item goes live on a timer. Highest bid when it hits zero takes it home — verified, sealed, shipped.

The Trust Layer

Every listing carries proof, not promises.

Authenticity is the biggest trust gap in resale. We close it before a single bid is placed — and the proof stays attached to the item for good.

AI

Authentication Model

Trained on brand reference imagery to flag logo placement, stitch patterns, hardware, and material inconsistencies.

QR

Unique Code Per Item

Generated only after verification passes — not reused, not editable, tied to that single physical piece.

✓

Buyer-Side Re-verification

Anyone can scan the QR after purchase to view the original authentication record and condition report.
